verdict: Maybe, for a deep-tech team. neuphony pitched a wearable EEG headband on Shark Tank India Season 2 and got a deal. EEG wearables for focus, sleep and mental health are a new market, but accurate brain signals are hard to capture and medical claims need approval.
angle: Consumer EEG headbands track focus, meditation and sleep. Medical uses, such as monitoring epilepsy or neurological conditions, need clinical validation and CDSCO approval. Software and subscription services add ongoing revenue.
